summary: Darwin binary opens PTY-over-WebSocket backdoor and harvests Anthropic API keys
details: The npm package ships a precompiled Mach-O binary at bin/sxt for darwin/amd64 with no source. The binary embeds a hardcoded WebSocket destination wss://relay.sextant.top and links github.com/creack/pty and github.com/coder/websocket, wiring remote WebSocket messages into a locally spawned PTY — a remote-controlled shell on the host that runs the CLI. The binary also embeds the regex sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,} and references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models, scraping and validating Anthropic API credentials on the host, and contacts http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query for host geolocation. package.json declares the license as 'SEE LICENSE IN https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control', a repository whose name matches the observed Claude-credential-harvest and remote-shell capabilities. The package has no scripts and no main entry — it is a platform-specific stub whose only artifact is the backdoor binary bin/sxt, together with a companion installer URL https://relay.sextant.top/install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
